advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace the bare "local" string comparisons in the sign-site guard, drift-refresh skip, and resign refusal with the canonical gate_source.SOURCE_LOCAL constant so a token rename cannot silently disable the never-sign guard.
evidence: resign.py: `if payload.get("source") == "local":` uses the same literal
advisory.finding: The local-source never-sign guard compares against the bare string literal "local" (source_mode == "local") while the codebase defines gate_source.SOURCE_LOCAL / repo_snapshot.SOURCE_LOCAL as the canonical constant; the same literal is duplicated in the drift-refresh skip, the resign refusal, and the sidecar. If the source-mode value ever changes, these guards silently become no-ops (the exact failure class this bug was — a structurally-silent guard).

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the exempt + source==local case is intended to fall through to the generic unsigned reason rather than the machine-readable local-source-never-signs reason, or hoist the source==local check above the exempt guard.
evidence: ABSENCE: no branch stamps reason=local-source-never-signs when source_mode=='local' and runner=='exempt'
advisory.finding: An exempt local-source PASS (runner == "exempt") falls through BOTH the new local-never-signs branch and the elif signing branch (both require runner != "exempt") to the else, yielding signature {signed:False, reason: verdict} rather than the machine-readable reason "local-source-never-signs". The distinct policy signal the sidecar/resign refusal relies on is not stamped for the exempt-local case; sidecar 'source' still records local so resign still refuses, but the verdict's in-band reason is less precise than for the non-exempt local case.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a direct test that sign_plan_review raises SigningError naming 'verified_at_sha would be None' when current_code_sha() returns falsy (no attested session).
evidence: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:126: `if not current_code_sha():` -> `raise SigningError("refusing to sign a plan-review attestation with no attested snapshot ...")`

The only SigningError-asserting test at the seam (test_sign_plan_review_refuses_non_certifiable_verdicts, tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py:1629) drives degraded/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE verdicts and matches on the generic 'refusing to sign' substring — it never sets current_code_sha() to None, so the null-pin branch is never entered.
ABSENCE: no test calls attest.sign_plan_review with current_code_sha monkeypatched to return None/'' and asserts the null-pin SigningError message.
advisory.finding: The new no-null-pin invariant at attest.sign_plan_review (raises SigningError when current_code_sha() is falsy) has no direct regression test. Existing coverage exercises it only indirectly via review_plan's own local-source never-sign guard (which short-circuits before sign_plan_review is even reached with source='local'), so a future refactor that removed the seam-level check but kept the review-time guard would pass every test while re-opening the loophole for OTHER signers (drift refresh, resign) that inherit the invariant.
advisory.suggested_fix: In a unit test, monkeypatch rebar.llm.config.current_code_sha to return None and assert attest.sign_plan_review(<PASS verdict>, material=...) raises SigningError whose message contains 'no attested snapshot' / 'verified_at_sha would be None'.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that when the attested snapshot is unavailable during sign-review, resign_plan_review returns a structured refusal (ok=False) with an actionable reason instead of raising.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py:250-260: `try: handle = gate_source.resolve_gate_handle(None, ...) ... except Exception: ... session = contextlib.nullcontext()`

ABSENCE: no test monkeypatches gate_source.resolve_gate_handle (or gate_read_root) to raise and asserts resign_plan_review returns a structured refusal (ok=False, signed=False) with a clear reason rather than propagating.
advisory.finding: The resign snapshot-unavailable fallback path is untested. When gate_source.resolve_gate_handle raises, resign.py logs a warning, substitutes contextlib.nullcontext(), then relies on sign_plan_review's null-pin invariant to produce a structured refusal. No test forces resolve_gate_handle to raise, so neither the fallback-to-nullcontext branch nor the resulting structured refusal (ok=False with an actionable reason instead of resign dying on ref resolution) is verified.
advisory.suggested_fix: Monkeypatch rebar.llm.gate_source.resolve_gate_handle to raise, run a signable-PASS sidecar through resign_plan_review, and assert the result is {'ok': False, 'signed': False} with a reason mentioning the missing attested snapshot/verified_at_sha.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that refresh_attestation raises SigningError ('refusing to drift-refresh ... no attested snapshot') when current_code_sha() is falsy.
evidence: attest.refresh_attestation new code (diff): `refreshed_at_sha = _current_code_sha(); if not refreshed_at_sha: ... raise SigningError('refusing to drift-refresh a plan-review attestation with no attested snapshot ...')`
tests/unit/test_plan_review_resign.py:83 test_drift_refresh_collects_and_emits_current_pins monkeypatches current_code_sha to 'c'*40 (success path only).
ABSENCE: no test drives refresh_attestation with current_code_sha() falsy to assert the drift-refresh null-pin SigningError.
advisory.finding: The new null-pin refusal branch inside attest.refresh_attestation (raises SigningError when _current_code_sha() is falsy) is not directly tested. Coverage for the refresh path (test_drift_refreshed_attestation_carries_a_verified_at_sha, test_drift_refresh_collects_and_emits_current_pins) only exercises the success case where a sha IS present; the refusal-on-null branch that keeps refresh from being the loophole the sign path closed is never entered.
advisory.suggested_fix: Monkeypatch current_code_sha to return None and assert attest.refresh_attestation(tid, prior_manifest, probe='PASS') raises SigningError naming the drift-refresh null-pin condition.
